srs: The investigation workflow system records Investigation, Task, InvestigationModule, and CaseRecord; each has an id attribute. Each Investigation can have zero or more Task records, and each Task belongs to exactly one Investigation. Each Task uses exactly one InvestigationModule, and each InvestigationModule serves zero or more Task records. Each InvestigationModule manages one or more CaseRecord records by composition, and each CaseRecord belongs to exactly one InvestigationModule. Each Investigation can reference zero or more CaseRecord records, and each CaseRecord can be referenced by zero or more Investigation records.
